online_top.sign_in_first_about: Connect Discord or play with a Mii on Player profile, and this page fills.

welcome.title: Play online, the easy way
welcome.subtitle: Connect Discord, or play with a Mii: no friend codes, no setup.
welcome.check_code: Go on only if the page there shows this code:
welcome.no_server: Online play needs a server: {{key}} in {{file}} is not a server's address (https://, or http:// for one on this computer or network).
welcome.no_answer: The server doesn't answer. The launcher tries again shortly.

one_click.title: Online in one click
one_click.text: Skip the Wii's friend codes and setup: your profile is ready in a minute, with Discord or a Mii.

challenges.title: Challenges over the game
challenges.text: Press {{key}} (or {{button}}) in the game for the Recharged Game Menu: see who is online and challenge them.

sets.title: Real sets, fair rules
sets.text: Best-of series by competitive rules that both players see before they accept.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.text: Your next tournament game, opponent and rules, in the game's Events tab. With Discord.

choices.discord: Your profile and Mii come from your Discord account. Brings your Discord friends, and tournaments when they start.
choices.mii: No account needed: choose a name and a Mii. Friends, challenges and sets work the same.
choices.no_mii: This server offers no Mii sign-in yet.
choices.footer: With Discord, your profile takes your Discord name and picture, and your friends list goes from Discord straight to this computer. A Mii player can connect Discord later and keeps their profile.

come_back.hint: Press Play and go online with {{mii}} (Online on the main menu): once it has logged in, the game signs you in again with the profile that Mii plays for.
come_back.hint_your_mii: Press Play and go online with your Mii (Online on the main menu): once it has logged in, the game signs you in again with the profile that Mii plays for.

mii.not_made: Your Mii could not be made: {{error}}

wizard.page_about: No account needed: a name and a Mii, and you're online.

blockers.mii_name: Your Mii's name has 1 to 10 characters, without emoji.
blockers.damaged: This computer's Mii database is damaged: import your Miis from Dolphin instead.
blockers.full: This computer has 100 Miis already: choose one of them.
blockers.has_profile: This Mii has a profile already: sign in with it.

wizard.step_1: Step 1 of 2: the name others see, and the Mii that plays for you.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.name_about: What others see in the lobby, in friend lists and in sets. Up to 32 characters.
wizard.mii_name_label: Your Mii's name in the game, up to 10 characters:
wizard.mii_name_line: In the game your Mii is called "{{mii}}".
wizard.your_mii_about: A new one, or one you have: on this computer, or in Dolphin.
wizard.random_face_note: A random face from the Wii's own Mii maker: roll another, or edit it. The Mii is made when you go online.
wizard.database_damaged: The game cannot read this computer's Mii database. Import your Miis from Dolphin instead.
wizard.no_miis: No Miis on this computer yet: make a new one, or import yours from Dolphin.
wizard.has_profile_named: {{mii}} plays for {{name}} already. Sign in again with it instead of making a second profile for this Mii, or choose another Mii.
wizard.has_profile_discord: {{mii}} plays for a profile with Discord already. Sign in again with it instead of making a second profile for this Mii, or choose another Mii.
wizard.has_profile_recharged: {{mii}} plays for a Recharged profile already. Sign in again with it instead of making a second profile for this Mii, or choose another Mii.
wizard.dolphin_about: Play with the Miis you have in Dolphin: they replace this computer's Miis (those are backed up first), then you choose yours.
wizard.no_dolphin_miis: No Dolphin Miis found. Choose Dolphin's user folder.
wizard.step_2: Step 2 of 2: Recharged signs you in with your name and your Mii.
wizard.mii_line_new: Your Mii "{{mii}}", made when you go online
wizard.no_password: No account and no password: this computer keeps you signed in. Friends, challenges and sets work as they do with Discord.
wizard.discord_later: Tournaments and Discord friends need Discord: connect it later on Player profile and your profile stays. After its first online game this Mii also brings you back if you sign out: log in with it in the game.
wizard.unreachable: The server can't be reached right now.

editor.name_rule: A Mii's name has 1 to 10 characters, without emoji.
editor.face_blocked: The Mii library can't draw this face.
editor.gone: This Mii is no longer among this computer's Miis, so it was not saved.
editor.not_saved: The Mii could not be saved: {{error}}
editor.about_new: Its face, name and favourite colour, drawn as the game draws its Miis. It is made when you go online.
editor.about_edit: Its face, name and favourite colour, drawn as the game draws its Miis. Saving keeps who it is online: its friend code and profile stay.
editor.parts_unreadable: The faces come from your game image's Mii parts, which can't be read.
editor.discord_name: Your Discord name names this Mii.
editor.name_about: Up to 10 characters: the game shows it with the Mii.

profile.about_mii: Your profile, your Mii and the server you play on.
profile.about_discord: Your profile, your Discord friends and the server you play on.
profile.account_mii_no_code: Account: Mii  ·  friend code after your first online game
profile.friend_code_about: For the game's own online menus.
profile.friend_code_mii_later: Your Mii gets one at its first online game.
profile.friend_code_later: A Mii gets one at its first online login in the game.
profile.friends_linked: Your Discord friends, and how many of them play Recharged.
profile.friends_missing: Builds made from source go without Discord friends.
profile.friends_not_linked: This server didn't link them with your sign-in: Link asks Discord once.
profile.flag_about: Beside your name for other players: the country you connect from, or one you choose.
profile.challenge_sound_about: A chime when someone challenges you or accepts your challenge, and the window flashes while it is in the background.
profile.discord_taken: {{error}} That Discord account plays with its own profile: to use it, sign out here and connect Discord on Player profile. Or connect another Discord account to this profile.

own_mii.discord: Plays your sets: made from your Discord name, the same on every computer.
own_mii.elsewhere: Not on this computer. Bring the game's data folder from the computer you play on: once your Mii has played online, Recharged finds it by its friend code.
own_mii.mii_account: Your profile's Mii: it plays your sets and online games.
own_mii.chosen: Plays your sets: the Mii of this computer you chose.

profile.discord_code: Finish in your browser. Go on only if the page there shows this code.
profile.discord_connect_about: Connect it for tournaments and your Discord friends. Your name, friends and Mii stay.

sign_out.title: Sign out?
sign_out.no_friend_code: This Mii hasn't played online yet: signing out loses this profile for good.
sign_out.come_back: You come back by logging in with this Mii in the game: start the game, go online with {{mii}}, and Recharged signs you in again. There is no password.
sign_out.come_back_your_mii: You come back by logging in with this Mii in the game: start the game, go online with your Mii, and Recharged signs you in again. There is no password.

mii_reuse.title: Play with a Mii you have?
mii_reuse.one: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has one already: play with it, or make a new one from your name.
mii_reuse.one_discord: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has one already: play with it, or make a new one from your Discord name.
mii_reuse.many_one: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has {{count}} already: play with one of them, or make a new one from your name.
mii_reuse.many_other: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has {{count}} already: play with one of them, or make a new one from your name.
mii_reuse.many_discord_one: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has {{count}} already: play with one of them, or make a new one from your Discord name.
mii_reuse.many_discord_other: Your profile plays online with a Mii. This computer has {{count}} already: play with one of them, or make a new one from your Discord name.

test_player.title: Test player
test_player.about: This test server signs you in with a name alone: for a second game on this computer, with its own settings file.

discord.not_offered: This server offers no Discord sign-in.
discord.library_missing: The Discord library does not load: {{error}}
discord.link_ended: Discord ended the link. Connect Discord again.
discord.sign_in_refused: Discord did not take the sign-in: {{error}}

service.no_answer: The server doesn't answer. Check your internet connection, then try again.
service.no_mii_sign_in: This server can't sign in players with a Mii yet.
service.too_many_players: Too many new players from your network just now. Try again later.
service.session_ended: You were signed out: the session ended. Sign in again.
service.sign_in_expired: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
service.connect_expired: Connecting Discord took too long. Try again.
service.connect_unsupported: This server can't connect Discord to a Mii profile yet.

rules.title: Match rules
rules.about: The rules your battles start from. Challenging a friend or searching for an opponent (in the game, {{key}}), you pick one and can still change any rule for that battle. Ranked matches and tournaments bring their own rules.
rules.none_yet: None yet: copy one above, or make a new one.
rules.fixed_tooltip: These rules come with Recharged and stay as they are. Copy them to change them.
rules.server_tooltip: Your server's rules: they stay as the server has them. Copy them to change them.
rules.copy_tooltip: A preset of your own from {{name}}.
rules.delete_tooltip: Click again to delete its file.

errors.bad_setting: a setting the game does not offer
errors.bad_setting_sentence: A setting the game does not offer.
errors.file_taken: Another file is called {{file}}: rename the preset.
errors.built_in_remove: The built-in presets cannot be removed.

preset_editor.title: Edit preset
preset_editor.about: Rules your battles can start from: a file of its own in {{folder}}.
preset_editor.name_rule: A name of 1 to 32 characters, without " [ ] = |, and neither {{retail}} nor {{competitive}}.
preset_editor.name: Name
preset_editor.series_about: Games in a series: one, or best of 3, 5 or 7.
preset_editor.win_by_goals: The first team to the goals wins.
preset_editor.win_by_time: The team ahead when time runs out wins.
preset_editor.stadium_about: Random: the host's game picks one, as in the game.
preset_editor.name_needed: Give it a name to save it.

sidekicks.title: Sidekicks
sidekicks.about: The sidekicks each captain starts with. The game's sidekick screen shows them, and what you choose there shows here: both live in your game save.
sidekicks.save_missing: There is no game save in the save folder in use yet. Play once: the game makes one when it first saves, and its lineups show here.
sidekicks.save_damaged: The game cannot read the save in the save folder in use, so its lineups are left as they are.
sidekicks.captains_about: Choose a captain to change the sidekicks that start with them.
sidekicks.lineup_about: Click a sidekick to put another one in their place. The change goes straight into the game save.
sidekicks.standard_about: {{sidekicks}}: the lineup a new save gives {{captain}}.

import.no_save: No Mario Strikers Charged save found in {{folder}}.
import.save_imported_backup: Dolphin save imported ({{files}}). Your previous save is in {{path}}.
import.miis_imported_backup: Dolphin Miis imported ({{names}}). Your previous Miis are in {{path}}.
import.replace_miis: They replace the game's Miis there; the current ones are backed up first.
import.replace_save: It replaces the game's save there; the current one is backed up first.

images.title: Game images
images.about: Click the image you want to play.
images.folder_missing: Your game folder is not there. Create it and put your Mario Strikers Charged images (ISO or RVZ) into it, connect its drive, or select another folder.
images.folder_empty: No Mario Strikers Charged images in your game folder. Put them into it, select another folder, or choose a file below.
images.limited: Only the first 2000 image files were looked at; select a folder closer to your images.
images.choose_file_tooltip:
Play an image that is not in your game folder.
You can also drop an image onto this window.
images.subfolders_tooltip_one: Also list the images in its subfolders ({{count}} level down).
images.subfolders_tooltip_other: Also list the images in its subfolders ({{count}} levels down).

note.command_line: From the command line: used for this run only.
note.folder_gone: Missing: its folder is not there. Connect its drive, or click to locate it.
note.file_gone: Missing: it was moved, renamed or deleted. Click to locate it.
note.build_unsupported: Not supported by this build yet.
note.revision_unsupported: This revision is not supported yet.
note.unreadable: Cannot be read: damaged or incomplete file.
note.outside: Chosen file outside your game folder.

images.open_folder_tooltip: Open the folder with this image.

language.unavailable: The saved language is not available in this version; the game uses Automatic ({{language}}). Choose one above.
